title: Finite allocation and placement evidence for W-1503

statePolicy.promotionRule: Não ratificar policy, effect ou placement source até os gates de HIR, escape, frames, target/linker/provider e diagnostics produzirem evidence independente.

officialRefs.claim: LLVM coroutine and frame lowering boundary

currentBoundary.memoryGeneralAllocatorNone: build-profile policy: no general/root allocator and no reachable general-allocation request; it does not select register, stack, static storage or task frame
currentBoundary.fixed: lexical current form with target-selected stack, task-frame or local/fixed placement
currentBoundary.bounded: Research budget over committed bytes on a provider; it does not select placement
currentBoundary.productGeneric: product is manifest/artifact selection; product<...> is not a generic source declaration or candidate
currentBoundary.workspace: current record is data-only; a new allocator policy field is a research candidate

candidates.constraint: module may preserve or restrict the workspace policy, never relax it
allocation: .forbid and stack: .bounded<maximum:N> are candidate contracts, not current syntax
.stack<capacity:N> would require guaranteed placement with no fallback

contractComparison.doesNotProve: placement, bounded stack use or no runtime/task-frame allocation

contractComparison.hypothesis: no allocation event is permitted in the declared scope, including provider, runtime, implicit frame or storage reservation unless the evidence classifies it as pre-existing
forbids: new native-stack or async-task-frame reservation unless separately classified
contractComparison.doesNotProve: a complete event taxonomy, that pre-existing storage is available, or physical placement

contractComparison.hypothesis: no dynamic/provider/runtime allocation may commit after admission in the declared scope
contractComparison.doesNotProve: no allocation event at all, bounded physical placement, escape safety or concurrency multiplication

allows: closed declared subset of register/elided, static/TLS, native stack, task frame and fixed/local
contractComparison.doesNotProve: target capacity, escape safety or concurrency multiplication

tasks.title: HIR allocation and storage taxonomy

outputs.observable: distinct allocation, storage, spill, static/TLS, task-frame and provider nodes
no-general-allocation, no-allocation and dynamic-allocation-forbid compared by scope

adversarialCases.expected: register/elision/free choice is not mistaken for stack proof
hidden runtime allocation is attributed to its HIR edge

tasks.stopCondition: Stop if storage classes, provider requests or effect scope are conflated, or if a result is selected by caller policy rather than HIR facts.

tasks.title: Stack, task frame, budget and target proof

outputs.observable: bounded stack/static/task-frame budgets with target guard/probing facts
native stack and async task-frame placement remain distinct

adversarialCases.expected: native stack guarantee does not silently cover a suspended task frame
recursion, indirect calls and generics are counted or rejected
per-task/thread multiplication consumes a bounded budget
guard pages, probing and target limits are evidenced

tasks.stopCondition: Stop on any fallback from a guaranteed stack candidate, uncounted recursion/task frame, or target/linker claim without receipt.

tasks.title: Escape, ABI, closures and public results

outputs.observable: closure, escape, FFI, alloca, unwind and drop paths are classified
fixed inline, caller destination or explicit rehome; never callee-frame escape

adversarialCases.expected: escaping closure cannot retain callee-frame storage
FFI and alloca remain explicit provider/ABI evidence
unwind/drop ordering remains valid before reclaim
public return uses inline, caller destination or rehome
separate compilation and inlining do not count as semantic proof

tasks.stopCondition: Stop on any callee-frame escape, caller-echoed placement, ABI summary without target facts or drop/reclaim mismatch.

tasks.title: Diagnostics, lowering and independent evidence

outputs.observable: w explain memory separates fact, decision, estimate, measurement and unknown
MLIR lowering preserves allocation/storage facts without selecting syntax
benchmarks record target, stack/frame budgets, allocations and equivalent values/errors

adversarialCases.expected: unknown placement is reported, not presented as fact
benchmark does not promote syntax or implementation

tasks.stopCondition: Stop before promotion if a diagnostic, lowering, provider receipt or benchmark cannot be reproduced independently.

blockers: target guard/probing, linker/interface and provider receipts
async frame model and concurrency multiplication
stopCondition: Stop on stale source or evidence, conflated policy/effect/placement, unbounded recursion or concurrency, closure or callee-frame escape, missing caller destination/rehome, ABI or linker assertion without target receipt, provider fallback, diagnostic unknown presented as fact, reducer divergence, or benchmark that changes values/errors. Reopen only with a bounded case, exact source, independent evidence and Sol review.
